_meta.purpose: Question battery for testing handoff-document fidelity. Each question targets a single atomic fact present in every variant of experiments/v2/handoff.* . Scoring is substring-match (case-insensitive): the answer counts as correct if it contains any string in `any_of`.
_meta.scoring: case-insensitive substring; an answer counts as correct if it contains ANY string in any_of
